project.name: domain-namespaced-di-fixture
project.purpose: Fixture: domain-namespaced DI IDs (DI-EQA-xxx, DI-BIO-xxx). Validates v0.2.7 pattern ^(DI|INV)(-[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*)?-\d+$.

design_invariants.label: mpmath-precision-lock
design_invariants.statement: Standard float64 is banned for high-stakes EQA evaluations. Must use arbitrary-precision libraries at >= 200-bit.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-052: Standard double-precision floats underflowed to absolute zero in multi-quadratic class field calculations.

design_invariants.label: clinical-boundary-mapping
design_invariants.statement: Bioscience audits must map model capabilities against the MIT AI Risk Repository to isolate high-risk biological surfaces.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-034: Ambiguity in bioclaw classification permitted unchecked deployment of synthetic biological sequence generators.

design_invariants.label: unmodified-run-provenance
design_invariants.statement: Verification run JSON data must remain completely unedited to preserve audit integrity.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-053: Editing local execution outputs invalidates public verification signatures.
